scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; independent finite enumeration verifies cases with two to four pairs. Infinite results are not inferred from enumeration. Publication priority is qualified by residual literature risks.
scientific_limitations: Common strict priority on one side, independent uniform complete preferences on the other, one independent uniform adjacent swap for each agent of the other side. The pivotal count is not the number of changed partners; unpublished equivalences remain possible. Generalization to arbitrary preferences is not asserted.
title: A Poisson law for simultaneous adjacent-swap robustness under common matching priorities
